F12 is complete and verified. Summary of this turn:

**F12 — a peer can deliver local-only message types**

`HandleMessageBatch` validates destination and cluster but not message *type*. Types reserved for the local node (`Election`, `LeaderHeartbeat`, `CheckQuorum`, `BatchedReadIndex`) are queued for the node and reach `Peer.Handle`, whose guard is `panic("local message sent to Step")`. One forged frame with `Type: Election` kills a member of a live cluster:

```
panic: local message sent to Step
  internal/raft.(*Peer).Handle              peer.go:187
  dragonboat.(*node).handleReceivedMessages node.go:1286
  dragonboat.(*engine).stepWorkerMain       engine.go:1240
```

The same gap has a quieter sibling: a wire `LocalTick` is consumed by `node.handleMessage`, so a peer can advance the node's clock rather than being ignored.

- [e2ereplicate](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/audit/tools/e2ereplicate/main.go) gained a `localmsg` mode; the captured tree dies ([log](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/audit/cover/f12/e2e_localmsg_stderr.txt)).
